title: Helm template escaping + secretRef rotation causing operator reconcile failures and suppressed drift alerts
creator: Rohan Patel
description: Multiple Private/VPC customers reported failed controller reconciliations immediately after operator upgrades. Root cause investigation indicates a Helm chart template escaping regression combined with secretRef rotation logic: when ExternalSecret controllers rotate credentials and Helm renders annotations with base64-encoded JSON, the operator's CRD admission validation rejects updates because certain annotation values are double-escaped. The drift detector suppressed the anomaly because the post-upgrade reconciliation returned 202 acceptances with no error body, leaving resources partially applied and causing downstream workload restarts. This ticket tracks a hotfix to the operator's validation path, a short rollback/patch rollout, and follow-up hardening to preflight and drift detection.
steps_to_reproduce: Set up on-prem operator v2.9.0 with ExternalSecrets enabled and a tenant that uses secretRefs in pod template annotations.
Create a secret that will be rotated by ExternalSecrets (simulate rotation by updating secret data).
Deploy an upgrade to operator v2.9.1 which includes Helm chart template updates that changed the annotation rendering helper.

Trigger a secret rotation immediately after upgrade and observe operator reconcile logs for the tenant's CR shows admission validation errors and 202 acceptances with empty body in the API server responses.
Observe that the drift-detector dashboard shows no alerts for this tenant due to the 202 acceptance path, but workloads exhibit restart loops and metrics (restarts, liveness failures) increase.
mitigation: Rollback operator to v2.9.0 for the most impacted customers (runbook link below) — executed for two tenants during initial incident response.
Apply temporary patch to helm render helper in the operator container to unescape annotation values before admission validation for on-prem clusters where rollback not possible.
Enable a short-lived webhook rule to reject 202-empty acceptance permutations and surface errors to drift-detector for immediate alerting.
Coordinate with SEs to notify affected customers and schedule maintenance windows for patch rollout where rollback is not permitted.
proposed_solution: Primary fix: change operator admission validation to canonicalize annotation values (unescape and validate canonical JSON) prior to schema validation; include unit tests for templates with base64-encoded JSON.
Patch Helm chart helper: make annotation helper idempotent (avoid adding escape sequences when input already escaped).
Improve API server response handling: treat 202 with empty body as a warning in reconcile loop and emit a structured event for drift-detector to ingest.
Add an integration test that simulates ExternalSecret rotation during upgrade rollouts to prevent regressions.
rollout_plan: Run CI (unit + integration) and a targeted canary rollout across 3 internal staging clusters.
Coordinate with Customer Success to pick 4 low-risk customer tenants for first customer-facing canary (post-noon PST maintenance window).
If canary passes for 24 hours, schedule progressive rollout to remaining Dedicated/Private clusters over 48 hours with automated monitoring gates.
If any gate fails, automatic rollback to operator-2.9.0 or stop-rollout and start incident EMERGENCY-PATCH plan.
qa_checks: Verify admission validation accepts annotation payloads that are raw JSON, escaped JSON, and base64-encoded JSON in unit tests.
Run end-to-end upgrade test with ExternalSecret rotation triggered at 3 points during rollout (pre-upgrade, during canary, post-upgrade) and assert no reconcile admission errors.
Confirm drift-detector emits an alert for the synthetic 202-empty acceptance condition in staging.
Confirm previously impacted customer tenants are stable for 24h post-patch (no restarts or new drift alerts).
monitoring: Create a dashboard tile for 'operator.reconcile.validation_errors' grouped by tenant and annotation key.
Add alert 'OperatorAdmissionValidationSpike' when validation_errors increase > 5x baseline for a tenant within 15 minutes.
Instrument reconcile path to emit structured events when API server returns 202 with empty body (include stacktrace and payload hash).
Add SLO guard to abort rollout when any canary tenant hits >3 restarts/hour after patch.
